ysop.title: YSOP Integrated Management Platform
ysop.subtitle: Unify access control, utilities, and safety for simpler, more reliable community operations
ysop.tagline: Four modules on one platform with cross-system event search—from field data to management decisions

meta.title: YSOP Integrated Management Platform
meta.description: YSOP integrates access control, utilities, safety systems, and operations with real-time alerts, automated workflows, and auditable reports for communities and smart buildings.

overview.title: All-in-one Building operations hub
overview.description: Access control, utilities, safety, and operations on one platform—from field data to management decisions.

overview_highlights.title: Four-module monitoring
overview_highlights.description: Access control, utilities, safety, and operations unified on one platform

overview_highlights.title: Real-time alerts & automation
overview_highlights.description: Environmental, fire, video, and access anomalies push alerts for faster on-site response

overview_highlights.title: Traceable records & reports
overview_highlights.description: Automated audit trails for payroll, compliance, and accountability

access_control.title: Access Control
access_control.description: Personnel and vehicle entry logs, groups, and reports—centralized exit management

utilities.title: Utilities
utilities.description: Monitor and control plumbing, ventilation, HVAC, lighting, and power points

safety.title: Safety Systems
safety.description: Environmental quality, smoke detection, fire protection, and emergency call integration

operations.title: Operations
operations.description: Digital signage, floor plans, alert logs, and personnel management

sub_features.access_mgmt: Access management — personnel entry logs, groups, and reports
sub_features.vehicle_mgmt: Vehicle management — vehicle entry logs, groups, and reports
sub_features.drainage: Plumbing & drainage — pump, sewage, and tank cover status
sub_features.air_circulation: Ventilation — supply/exhaust and duct fan status
sub_features.power: Power systems — fuel odor and generator status
sub_features.lighting: Lighting — point monitoring and switch control
sub_features.hvac: HVAC — point monitoring and switch control
sub_features.environment: Environmental quality — real-time values, alerts, and reports
sub_features.smoke_alarm: Smoke detection — with CO2 and other sensors
sub_features.fire: Fire protection — pump and tank cover status
sub_features.emergency_rescue: Emergency call — with emergency bell integration
sub_features.multimedia: Digital signage — community announcements and schedules
sub_features.floor_plan: Floor plan — all system points and status at a glance
sub_features.alert_records: Alert logs — traceable records and alert rule linkage
sub_features.elevator: Elevator management — real-time values, alerts, and reports
sub_features.surveillance: Video surveillance — alert linkage and live monitoring

pain_points.title: Fragmented systems
pain_points.description: Utilities, access, and devices from different vendors make integration and lookup difficult

pain_points.title: Alerts disconnected from the field
pain_points.description: Alerts push separately with no unified log—staff must cross-reference floors and points across systems

pain_points.title: Data overload
pain_points.description: Access, video, and license plate systems operate in silos—events cannot be cross-referenced

ysop.pain_points_subheading: Do you truly have full visibility into what happens in your community?

comparison.traditional: Siloed systems with data scattered across vendors
comparison.ours: Four modules on one platform with cross-system event search

comparison.traditional: Environmental issues or violations discovered only after the fact
comparison.ours: Real-time alerts + automated detection—issues handled on the spot

comparison.traditional: Reports compiled manually, hard to verify decisions
comparison.ours: Automated traceable records for payroll, audits, and accountability

poc.title: Bring visibility and control back to the field
steps: Site survey — focus on a community or site you designate
POC pilot — one workflow, validated in 4–6 weeks
